title: How to Brew Drip Bag Coffee

scenes.heading: Get ready
lines: Prepare a mug, a drip coffee bag and a kettle.
Boil the water and let it cool to about ninety degrees Celsius.

scenes.heading: Open the bag
lines: Hold the bag with both hands, tear off the top strip along the marked line.
Open it gently to avoid spilling the coffee.

scenes.heading: Attach it to the mug
lines: Spread the paper hooks, attach them to the rim of your mug.
Check that the bag is secure before letting go.

scenes.heading: Let the coffee bloom
lines: To moisten the coffee evenly, pour a little hot water into the bag.
Let it bloom for twenty seconds to release the aroma.

scenes.heading: Pour slowly
lines: With the kettle ready, pour slowly in two or three rounds.
Wait for the water to drain between pours so the bag does not overflow.

scenes.heading: Remove and enjoy
lines: Once the water has drained, remove the bag from the mug.

strings.prepare.callout: Prepare your tools and hot water
